### ✨ New Features

* Remove a video from the history, and keep the history screen's system bars in its own color ([7cc95b6](https://github.com/mahirsn/mahirsn-patches/commit/7cc95b6fa506e389e3a251b9efa34631e57a489d))

patches.name: Watch history on your server
patches.description: Keeps the watch history and resume positions on your own server instead of Google's, so YouTube's history can stay off. Adds a Personal history section to the Morphe settings. Requires Morphe official patches and a yt-history server.

options.description: Base URL of the history API of your yt-history server.
Sent to the server in the X-Token header. Leave empty to use YT_HISTORY_TOKEN from the environment or from ~/.config/env/yt-history on the computer that patches.
